API_KEY.description: API key from your Agent Helper dashboard.

ORIGIN_SECRET.description: Optional. Sent to your origin as X-Agent-Helper-Secret so it can trust injected payment headers.

ORIGIN_URL.description: Leave blank if you'll attach this worker to a route on your API's Cloudflare domain (recommended). Otherwise, the base URL of your existing API, e.g. https://api.example.com

APP_API_URL.description: Agent Helper API base URL. Leave the default.
